description: This header file defines classes, enumerations, and structures related to navigation categories and view modes within a calculator application. It includes metadata for different calculator modes, category groupings, and static helper functions for querying and managing navigation states.

classes.name: NavCategory
classes.description: Represents a navigation category with properties like name, glyph, view mode, and support for negative values. Implements INotifyPropertyChanged for data binding.

classes.name: NavCategoryGroup
classes.description: Represents a group of navigation categories, including its name, type, and contained categories.

classes.name: NavCategoryStates
classes.description: Provides static methods to manage navigation states, create menu options, and query view modes and categories.

methods.name: IsCalculatorViewMode
methods.description: Checks if a given view mode is a calculator mode.

methods.name: IsGraphingCalculatorViewMode
methods.description: Checks if a given view mode is a graphing calculator mode.

methods.name: IsDateCalculatorViewMode
methods.description: Checks if a given view mode is a date calculator mode.

methods.name: IsConverterViewMode
methods.description: Checks if a given view mode is a converter mode.

methods.name: SetCurrentUser
methods.description: Sets the current user for navigation state management.

methods.name: CreateMenuOptions
methods.description: Creates and returns the list of navigation category groups for the menu.

methods.name: CreateCalculatorCategoryGroup
methods.description: Creates the calculator category group.

methods.name: CreateConverterCategoryGroup
methods.description: Creates the converter category group.

methods.name: IsValidViewMode
methods.description: Checks if a view mode is valid.

methods.name: IsViewModeEnabled
methods.description: Checks if a view mode is enabled.

methods.name: Serialize
methods.description: Serializes a view mode to an integer for storage.

methods.name: Deserialize
methods.description: Deserializes an object to a view mode.

methods.name: GetViewModeForFriendlyName
methods.description: Retrieves a view mode based on its friendly name.

methods.name: GetFriendlyName
methods.description: Gets the friendly name for a view mode.

methods.name: GetNameResourceKey
methods.description: Gets the resource key for the view mode name.

methods.name: GetGroupType
methods.description: Gets the category group type for a view mode.

methods.name: GetIndex
methods.description: Gets the 0-based index of a view mode.

methods.name: GetFlatIndex
methods.description: Gets the flat index of a view mode.

methods.name: GetIndexInGroup
methods.description: Gets the index of a view mode within a specific group type.

methods.name: GetPosition
methods.description: Gets the 1-based position of a view mode.

methods.name: GetViewModeForVirtualKey
methods.description: Retrieves the view mode associated with a virtual key.

methods.name: GetCategoryAcceleratorKeys
methods.description: Retrieves the list of virtual keys for category shortcuts.
